name: Scoring Rubric for Unicorn Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of unicorn illustration. Focuses on synecdoche understanding, water as reflective metaphor, and text-image relationship.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual synecdoche, understanding of water as potential mirror, and interpretation of text as verbalized denial.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand that horn and star represent the whole unicorn?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of synecdoche, understands its thematic significance (part representing essence), and connects to story's theme of being 'defined neskutečně přesně'.
AI recognizes synecdoche and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices horn and star but analysis is superficial or literal.
AI treats horn and star as mere decoration or fails to see representational function.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive water as potential mirror and connect to reflection scene in story?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies water as reflective surface, connects to story's reflection scene, and understands its metaphorical function (self-awareness, confrontation).
AI recognizes water as potentially reflective and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices water but analysis is superficial.
AI treats water as mere setting or misses reflective possibility.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the relationship between denial text and visual presence of unicorn?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of text-image relationship, understands text as unicorn's voice, and interprets placement (dole u vody) as significant.
AI recognizes relationship and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices connection but analysis is superficial.
AI treats text and image as separate or misinterprets their relation.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (full unicorn, origin scene, reflection) and presence (horn, star, woman, text) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as emphasis on essence over form.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct synecdoche from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about water and reflection?
overall_assessment_guidance: The unicorn illustration particularly tests understanding of synecdoche and reflective symbolism. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding part-whole relationships and metaphorical reflection.
